name: @inlve/dsh-toolchain-env
description: Expose manager-owned toolchains (fnm, pnpm, pyenv, volta, scoop, ...) to every DSH child process by composing the host PATH, with a browsable settings panel, discovery, audit, and diagnostics
author: Inlve

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check lib/pathset.js && node --check lib/discover.js && node --check lib/scan.js && node --check lib/entries.js && node --check lib/versions.js && node --check lib/audit.js
scripts.test: node --test --test-isolation=none test/pathset.test.mjs test/discover.test.mjs test/versions.test.mjs test/entries.test.mjs test/scan.test.mjs test/apply.test.mjs
